name: Soracom, Inc.
summary: Soracom, Inc. provides Internet of Things (IoT) based platform in the Japan, the United Kingdom, and the United States. The company offers SORACOM, a platform for the development and operation of IoT-enabled products and services; SORACOM IoT Store, an online shop to purchase and test SIM cards and devices; SORACOM Professional Services which provides assistance in organizing technical elements, challenges, and action plans for large-scale commercial deployments; and SORACOM Engineering Services. It also provides Soracam, a cloud-based camera service; Soracom Mobile, a prepaid eSIM data communication service; Soracom Cloud MFA that delivers one-time authentication codes to mobile phones; and…
